title: Hang on, there’s a Trump Phone Ultra coming too?
titleZh: 寻找下落不明的特朗普手机——等等，Ultra？
summary:
特朗普手机究竟在哪里？我们每周都会持续关注此事。和以往一样，我们已再次就特朗普手机的下落提出询问。也和以往一样，我们仍在等待答复。而与此同时，最新情况显示，需要我们操心的特朗普手机可能不止一部。尽管第一代特朗普手机至今仍只是捕风捉影的传闻，但特朗普移动（Trump Mobile）却已在筹划其第二代产品。该公司一名高管在采访时透露，一款名为“T1 Ultra”的机型也已进入研发阶段，只是与尚未面世的第一代相比，外界对这款新机的了解甚至更少。

来源：The Verge；作者：Dominic Preston；原文发布时间：2026-01-25 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Where’s the Trump Phone? We’re going to keep talking about it every week. We’ve reached out, as usual, to ask about the Trump Phone’s whereabouts. As usual, we’re still waiting for a response. In the meantime, it turns out we might have two Trump Phones to worry about. The Trump Phone may be no more than a whisper in the wind, but Trump Mobile is already planning a second. One of the company’s top executives revealed in an interview that a “T1 Ultra” is also in the works, though we know even less about it than we do about the first phone.
paragraphs.contentZh: 特朗普手机究竟在哪里？我们每周都会持续关注此事。和以往一样，我们已再次就特朗普手机的下落提出询问。也和以往一样，我们仍在等待答复。而与此同时，最新情况显示，需要我们操心的特朗普手机可能不止一部。尽管第一代特朗普手机至今仍只是捕风捉影的传闻，但特朗普移动（Trump Mobile）却已在筹划其第二代产品。该公司一名高管在采访时透露，一款名为“T1 Ultra”的机型也已进入研发阶段，只是与尚未面世的第一代相比，外界对这款新机的了解甚至更少。

paragraphs.contentEn: The unexpected comments were made by Don Hendrickson, one of the three executives Trump Mobile brought out on stage at the service’s launch, described then as its head of mobile operations. Last November, he spoke to trade publication Wireless Dealer Magazine in an interview that has so far gone largely unnoticed, but ends with a tantalizing tease of the company’s future hardware.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这番出人意料的言论出自唐·亨德里克森，特朗普移动在服务发布会上登台亮相的三位高管之一，当时他的身份被介绍为移动终端运营负责人。去年11月，亨德里克森接受了行业刊物《无线经销商杂志》的采访，这篇访谈迄今几乎无人关注，但在结尾部分，他却对公司的未来硬件布局抛出了一段耐人寻味的暗示。

paragraphs.contentEn: “We’re focused on evolving with our customers by offering even more powerful tools that fit their lives,” Hendrickson said. “Our next major step is the launch of the T1 Ultra — a premium device that builds on the success of the original T1 with enhanced performance, upgraded features, and the same bold, American-proud design.” “The T1 Ultra will offer a top-tier user experience while staying true to our mission of combining value, functionality, and patriotic branding. As we expand, expect to see more integrated services, exclusive perks, and new product tiers — always centered around the same promise: delivering more than just wireless and doing it the Trump℠ Mobile way,” he added.
paragraphs.contentZh: 亨德里克森表示：“公司正致力于与用户共同成长，持续推出更强大、更贴近日常生活的产品与服务。我们的下一项重要举措是推出T1 Ultra——这是一款定位高端的机型，将在初代T1的成功基础上，进一步提升性能、升级功能，并延续其大胆、彰显美国精神的设计风格。”他补充道：“T1 Ultra力求在恪守品牌使命的同时，为用户提供一流的使用体验，将性价比、功能性与爱国品牌形象融为一体。随着业务的不断拓展，用户还可期待更多整合服务、专属权益以及新的产品层级——而这一切都围绕同一承诺展开：我们交付的不仅是无线通信，更是独特的Trump℠ Mobile体验。”

paragraphs.contentEn: There’s a lot to unpack here. First is the claim to be building on “the success of the original T1,” a phone that is now five months late and counting, sparking Democratic lawmakers to write to the FTC asking it to investigate. Can an unlaunched phone really be a success? I suppose it depends how many $100 deposits the company has taken, though as I reported last week, we still don’t know what that figure looks like. Unsurprisingly for a phone to be branded “Ultra,” the new handset will apparently have “enhanced performance” and “upgraded features,” though Hendrickson is vague on the details. The original T1 promises budget specs at a midrange price — though we still don’t know some core elements like what chipset it uses — so there’s plenty of room for an Ultra to improve on it.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这番表态中有不少内容值得推敲。首先，便是“在初代T1的成功基础上继续打造”这一说法，初代T1已延期发布五个月，至今仍不见踪影，甚至引发民主党议员致信联邦贸易委员会，要求其介入调查。一款尚未面世的手机，能否被称为成功？我想，这或许取决于特朗普移动收到了多少笔100美元的预订金，只是正如我上周报道的，具体数字外界仍一无所知。不出所料，这款敢冠以“Ultra”之名的手机，被描述为拥有“更强的性能”和“升级的功能”，但亨德里克森并未给出任何具体细节。初代T1的定位是以中端手机的价格提供入门级的配置——甚至连其搭载的芯片这类核心信息至今都未公开——在这样的背景下，Ultra版本的确拥有不小的提升空间。

paragraphs.contentEn: The name, of course, echoes Samsung’s Galaxy S Ultra line, though similar branding has been adopted by the likes of Xiaomi, Vivo, Asus (RIP), Oppo, and Honor. For the most part, those phones feature the latest Qualcomm Snapdragon flagship chips, triple or quadruple rear cameras with advanced telephoto lenses, and cost north of $1,000. Anything similar would be a big jump from the $499 T1 Phone, though the promise of “new product tiers” suggests an ambition to hit other price points in the future too.
paragraphs.contentZh: 当然，T1 Ultra这一命名显然借鉴了三星Galaxy S Ultra系列的思路，小米、Vivo、华硕（手机业务已终止）、OPPO和荣耀等品牌，也已广泛采用了类似的命名策略。这类Ultra机型普遍搭载最新一代的高通骁龙旗舰芯片，配备拥有先进长焦镜头的后置三摄或四摄系统，且售价普遍高于1000美元。任何与之相近的配置，对于起价仅499美元的T1手机而言，都将是一次巨大的跨越。不过，“推出新的产品层级”这一表述，也透露出特朗普移动未来有意覆盖更多价格区间的野心。

paragraphs.contentEn: Then there’s the manufacturing. Having learned from Trump Mobile’s initial made-in-America walk back, Hendrickson only says the T1 Ultra will have “American-proud design,” the same wording currently used to describe the T1. We’ve yet to find out what exactly that means, or precisely how gold we should expect the T1 Ultra to be. Can American-proud design compete with the Chinese retail giant JD.com, apparently about to start selling pure gold iPhone cases for up to $16,000?
paragraphs.contentZh: 再来看制造层面。显然是吸取了特朗普移动此前被迫回撤美国制造这一表述的教训，亨德里克森此次仅表示T1 Ultra将采用彰显美国精神的设计，这与目前用于描述初代T1的措辞完全一致。我们尚不清楚这一表述具体指什么，也无从得知T1 Ultra在外观上会镀金到何种程度。当中国零售巨头京东据传即将开售售价高达1.6万美元的纯金iPhone手机壳时，这种彰显美国精神的设计，在奢华赛道上又能展现出多少竞争力呢？

paragraphs.contentEn: Still, there’s reason to doubt in the T1 Ultra, beyond the obvious. Hendrickson claims that “customers are drawn to… the exclusive T1 Ultra phone,” and “eager to buy into” it, an impossibility for a phone that hadn’t even been mentioned publicly before this interview was published. Were the T1 and the T1 Ultra getting muddled together, or was this a prewritten interview intended to go live after a full Ultra announcement that never took place? The Ultra isn’t the only interesting tidbit in Hendrickson’s interview. He also claims to have been the originator of the Trump Mobile idea, claiming he “approached [the Trumps] with the concept,” because “they know how to build movements, not just businesses.” So now we know who to thank for all this.
paragraphs.contentZh: 抛开那些显而易见的疑点不谈，我们仍有理由对T1 Ultra的真实性提出质疑。亨德里克森声称，“消费者被这款独家推出的T1 Ultra所吸引”，并且“迫切希望购买”，然而在这篇采访发表前，这款手机从未公开亮相，这样的说法显然难以成立。究竟是他将T1与T1 Ultra混为一谈，还是采访稿原本是为一场从未举行的Ultra发布会所预先准备？在这次采访中，引人关注的不止Ultra这一个细节。亨德里克森还宣称，自己才是特朗普移动概念的创始人，是他“带着这个构想找到了特朗普家族”，因为“他们擅长缔造潮流，而不仅仅是经营生意”。好了，现在我们总算知道该感谢谁了。

paragraphs.contentEn: And if you’re wondering about the curious “Trump℠,” which you might have seen pop up before in places like the Trump Mobile website small print, it’s the symbol for a service mark — a variant on the trademark used for services, rather than physical products, and which indicates that the Trump trademark for the mobile industry has been applied for, but not yet approved. It’s yet another element of Trump Mobile that’s still more fiction than fact. As ever, Trump Mobile didn’t reply to my request for comment.
paragraphs.contentZh: 如果你曾对那个略显蹊跷的“Trump℠”标识感到疑惑（它或许出现在特朗普移动官网底部的细则说明中），这里需要稍作说明，℠是服务商标标识——属于商标的一种变体，用于标识服务而非实体产品，这也意味着，Trump这一名称在移动通信领域的商标虽已提交申请，但尚未获得正式批准。这不过是特朗普移动设想多于事实的又一例证。至于评论请求，一如既往，特朗普移动并未作出回应。
